title: Worker briefs and kb-worker.md forbid making git worktrees outside the one the orchestrator gives
goal: kb-worker.md and the /kb-sprint run brief (the fixed rules in _tools/bl_dispatch.py WORKER_RULES) say a worker makes no git worktree of its own (a baseline run uses git stash or a scratch clone it can delete, never git worktree add), since git worktree remove is denied to agents and such a worktree is left for the operator. Answers the SP-caqrexqw close: ST-urfa4ntj's worker added _cache/scratch/ST-urfa4ntj/base for a baseline run and could not remove it. The same edit of kb-worker.md rule 1 names the worker's _cache/scratch/<id>/ as the directory of its .claude/ staging copies, where it now says 'the orchestrator's scratch directory' (as run step 3 and backlog.md name it).

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_dispatch as d;w=open(".claude/agents/kb-worker.md",encoding="utf-8").read();a="_cache/scratch/" in w;b="git worktree add" in w and any("git worktree add" in r for r in d.WORKER_RULES);print("kb-worker names the scratch directory:",a,"; role file and brief forbid git worktree add:",b);sys.exit(0 if a and b else 1)
